tip.putInNote: What the jars have received this month. Money you take out by hand is subtracted. Money spent from a jar is not.
tip.stillNote: What the jars still need to reach their monthly amounts.
tip.availNote: Money you can put into jars right now.
tip.noAutoN: Nothing goes into this jar by itself. Edit the jar to set an amount per month.
tip.fullBillN: It has all it needs. It tops up whenever it drops.
tip.fundedN: This jar has what it needs for this month.
tip.partlyN: It takes the rest as soon as there is free money.
tip.priorityN: Jars fill in this order, so jar 1 gets free money first. Click to pick a place, or use the arrows.
tip.paidMonth: Paid from this jar this month

nothing: Nothing to fill: every jar already has its share this month, or there is no money available
